# Entrana dungeon

A pocket of the Taverley Dungeon's map square, joined to it by no passage: Entrana's cave-monk ladder (areas/area_entrana/scripts/cave_monk.rs2:13) comes down at (2822, 9774) and its only way out is a portal to the Wilderness (entrana_dungeon.rs2:8). The rects are the collision flood fill from the landing plus a margin that stops short of the Taverley Dungeon's own tiles; conductor/lib/connectors.ts holds a copy of them (UNDERGROUND_AREAS), pinned together by conductor/test/lib/connectors.test.ts.
